summary.en: Claude Opus 4.7 plus DeepSeek V4 Flash/Pro on OmniMux.
summary.zh: Claude Opus 4.7 与 DeepSeek V4 Flash/Pro 已在 OmniMux 可调用。

body.en:
## Claude Opus 4.7 and DeepSeek V4

New language models are available on OmniMux Chat Completions.

### New models

| Model ID | Brand |
| --- | --- |
| `claude-opus-4-7` | Claude |
| `deepseek-v4-flash` | DeepSeek |
| `deepseek-v4-pro` | DeepSeek |

### API

- **Endpoint:** `https://api.omnimux.ai/v1` (Chat Completions)
